name: cad-designer
description: Text-to-CAD prototype: NL prompt -> LLM -> Replicad (in-browser) -> 3D solid + STEP/STL export

scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
